en.1:1: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, to the chosen ones who are living as foreigners in the Dispersion in Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,
en.1:2: according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, in sanctification of the Spirit, that you may obey Jesus Christ and be sprinkled with his blood: Grace to you and peace be multiplied.
en.1:3: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who according to his great mercy caused us to be born again to a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,
en.1:4: to an incorruptible and undefiled inheritance that doesn’t fade away, reserved in Heaven for you,
en.1:5: who by the power of God are guarded through faith for a salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.
en.1:6: In this you greatly rejoice, though now for a little while, if need be, you have been grieved in various trials,
en.1:7: that the proof of your faith, which is more precious than gold that perishes, even though it is tested by fire, may be found to result in praise, glory, and honor at the revelation of Jesus Christ—
en.1:8: whom, not having known, you love. In him, though now you don’t see him, yet believing, you rejoice greatly with joy that is unspeakable and full of glory,
en.1:9: receiving the result of your faith, the salvation of your souls.
en.1:10: Concerning this salvation, the prophets sought and searched diligently. They prophesied of the grace that would come to you,
en.1:11: searching for who or what kind of time the Spirit of Christ which was in them pointed to when he predicted the sufferings of Christ and the glories that would follow them.
en.1:12: To them it was revealed that they served not themselves, but you, in these things, which now have been announced to you through those who preached the Good News to you by the Holy Spirit sent out from heaven; which things angels desire to look into.
en.1:13: Therefore prepare your minds for action. Be sober, and set your hope fully on the grace that will be brought to you at the revelation of Jesus Christ—
en.1:14: as children of obedience, not conforming yourselves according to your former lusts as in your ignorance,
en.1:15: but just as he who called you is holy, you yourselves also be holy in all of your behavior,
en.1:16: because it is written, “You shall be holy, for I am holy.”
en.1:17: If you call on him as Father, who without respect of persons judges according to each man’s work, pass the time of your living as foreigners here in reverent fear,
en.1:18: knowing that you were redeemed, not with corruptible things like silver or gold, from the useless way of life handed down from your fathers,
en.1:19: but with precious blood, as of a lamb without blemish or spot, the blood of Christ,
en.1:20: who was foreknown indeed before the foundation of the world, but was revealed in this last age for your sake,
en.1:21: who through him are believers in God, who raised him from the dead and gave him glory, so that your faith and hope might be in God.
en.1:22: Seeing you have purified your souls in your obedience to the truth through the Spirit in sincere brotherly affection, love one another from the heart fervently,
en.1:23: having been born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, through the word of God, which lives and remains forever.
en.1:24: For, “All flesh is like grass, and all of man’s glory like the flower in the grass. The grass withers, and its flower falls;
en.1:25: but the Lord’s word endures forever.” This is the word of Good News which was preached to you.
en.2:1: Putting away therefore all wickedness, all deceit, hypocrisies, envies, and all evil speaking,
en.2:2: as newborn babies, long for the pure spiritual milk, that with it you may grow,
en.2:3: if indeed you have tasted that the Lord is gracious.
en.2:4: Come to him, a living stone, rejected indeed by men, but chosen by God, precious.
en.2:5: You also as living stones are built up as a spiritual house, to be a holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices, acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.
en.2:6: Because it is contained in Scripture, “Behold, I lay in Zion a chief cornerstone, chosen and precious. He who believes in him will not be disappointed.”
en.2:7: For you who believe therefore is the honor, but for those who are disobedient, “The stone which the builders rejected has become the chief cornerstone,”
en.2:8: and, “a stumbling stone and a rock of offense.” For they stumble at the word, being disobedient, to which also they were appointed.
en.2:9: But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, that you may proclaim the excellence of him who called you out of darkness into his marvelous light.
en.2:10: In the past, you were not a people, but now are God’s people, who had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.
en.2:11: Beloved, I beg you as foreigners and pilgrims to abstain from fleshly lusts which war against the soul,
en.2:12: having good behavior among the nations, so in that of which they speak against you as evildoers, they may see your good works and glorify God in the day of visitation.
en.2:13: Therefore subject yourselves to every ordinance of man for the Lord’s sake: whether to the king, as supreme,
en.2:14: or to governors, as sent by him for vengeance on evildoers and for praise to those who do well.
en.2:15: For this is the will of God, that by well-doing you should put to silence the ignorance of foolish men.
en.2:16: Live as free people, yet not using your freedom for a cloak of wickedness, but as bondservants of God.
en.2:17: Honor all men. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honor the king.
en.2:18: Servants, be in subjection to your masters with all respect, not only to the good and gentle, but also to the wicked.
en.2:19: For it is commendable if someone endures pain, suffering unjustly, because of conscience toward God.
en.2:20: For what glory is it if, when you sin, you patiently endure beating? But if when you do well, you patiently endure suffering, this is commendable with God.
en.2:21: For you were called to this, because Christ also suffered for us, leaving you an example, that you should follow his steps,
en.2:22: who didn’t sin, “neither was deceit found in his mouth.”
en.2:23: When he was cursed, he didn’t curse back. When he suffered, he didn’t threaten, but committed himself to him who judges righteously.
en.2:24: He himself bore our sins in his body on the tree, that we, having died to sins, might live to righteousness. You were healed by his wounds.
en.2:25: For you were going astray like sheep; but now you have returned to the Shepherd and Overseer of your souls.
en.3:1: In the same way, wives, be in subjection to your own husbands, so that, even if any don’t obey the Word, they may be won by the behavior of their wives without a word,
en.3:2: seeing your pure behavior in fear.
en.3:3: Let your beauty come not from the outward adorning of braiding your hair, and of wearing gold ornaments or of putting on fine clothing,
en.3:4: but from the hidden person of the heart, in the incorruptible adornment of a gentle and quiet spirit, which is very precious in God’s sight.
en.3:5: For this is how in the past the holy women who hoped in God also adorned themselves, being in subjection to their own husbands.
en.3:6: So Sarah obeyed Abraham, calling him lord, whose children you now are if you do well and are not put in fear by any terror.
en.3:7: You husbands, in the same way, live with your wives according to knowledge, giving honor to the woman as to the weaker vessel, as also being joint heirs of the grace of life, that your prayers may not be hindered.
en.3:8: Finally, all of you be like-minded, compassionate, loving as brothers, tenderhearted, courteous,
en.3:9: not rendering evil for evil or insult for insult; but instead blessing, knowing that you were called to this, that you may inherit a blessing.
en.3:10: For, “He who would love life and see good days, let him keep his tongue from evil and his lips from speaking deceit.
en.3:11: Let him turn away from evil and do good. Let him seek peace and pursue it.
en.3:12: For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous, and his ears open to their prayer; but the face of the Lord is against those who do evil.”
en.3:13: Now who will harm you if you become imitators of that which is good?
en.3:14: But even if you should suffer for righteousness’ sake, you are blessed. “Don’t fear what they fear, neither be troubled.”
en.3:15: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts. Always be ready to give an answer to everyone who asks you a reason concerning the hope that is in you, with humility and fear,
en.3:16: having a good conscience. Thus, while you are spoken against as evildoers, they may be disappointed who curse your good way of life in Christ.
en.3:17: For it is better, if it is God’s will, that you suffer for doing what is right than for doing evil.
en.3:18: Because Christ also suffered for sins once, the righteous for the unrighteous, that he might bring you to God, being put to death in the flesh, but made alive in the Spirit,
en.3:19: in whom he also went and preached to the spirits in prison,
en.3:20: who before were disobedient when God waited patiently in the days of Noah while the ship was being built. In it, few, that is, eight souls, were saved through water.
en.3:21: This is a symbol of baptism, which now saves you—not the putting away of the filth of the flesh, but the answer of a good conscience toward God—through the resurrection of Jesus Christ,
en.3:22: who is at the right hand of God, having gone into heaven, angels and authorities and powers being made subject to him.
en.4:1: Therefore, since Christ suffered for us in the flesh, arm yourselves also with the same mind; for he who has suffered in the flesh has ceased from sin,
en.4:2: that you no longer should live the rest of your time in the flesh for the lusts of men, but for the will of God.
en.4:3: For we have spent enough of our past time doing the desire of the Gentiles, and having walked in lewdness, lusts, drunken binges, orgies, carousings, and abominable idolatries.
en.4:4: They think it is strange that you don’t run with them into the same excess of riot, speaking evil of you.
en.4:5: They will give account to him who is ready to judge the living and the dead.
en.4:6: For to this end the Good News was preached even to the dead, that they might be judged indeed as men in the flesh, but live as to God in the spirit.
en.4:7: But the end of all things is near. Therefore be of sound mind, self-controlled, and sober in prayer.
en.4:8: And above all things be earnest in your love among yourselves, for love covers a multitude of sins.
en.4:9: Be hospitable to one another without grumbling.
en.4:10: As each has received a gift, employ it in serving one another, as good managers of the grace of God in its various forms.
en.4:11: If anyone speaks, let it be as it were the very words of God. If anyone serves, let it be as of the strength which God supplies, that in all things God may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom belong the glory and the dominion forever and ever. Amen.
en.4:12: Beloved, don’t be astonished at the fiery trial which has come upon you to test you, as though a strange thing happened to you.
en.4:13: But because you are partakers of Christ’s sufferings, rejoice, that at the revelation of his glory you also may rejoice with exceeding joy.
en.4:14: If you are insulted for the name of Christ, you are blessed, because the Spirit of glory and of God rests on you. On their part he is blasphemed, but on your part he is glorified.
en.4:15: But let none of you suffer as a murderer, or a thief, or an evil doer, or a meddler in other men’s matters.
en.4:16: But if one of you suffers for being a Christian, let him not be ashamed; but let him glorify God in this matter.
en.4:17: For the time has come for judgment to begin with the household of God. If it begins first with us, what will happen to those who don’t obey the Good News of God?
en.4:18: “If it is hard for the righteous to be saved, what will happen to the ungodly and the sinner?”
en.4:19: Therefore let them also who suffer according to the will of God in doing good entrust their souls to him, as to a faithful Creator.
en.5:1: Therefore I exhort the elders among you, as a fellow elder and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, and who will also share in the glory that will be revealed:
en.5:2: shepherd the flock of God which is among you, exercising the oversight, not under compulsion, but voluntarily; not for dishonest gain, but willingly;
en.5:3: not as lording it over those entrusted to you, but making yourselves examples to the flock.
en.5:4: When the chief Shepherd is revealed, you will receive the crown of glory that doesn’t fade away.
en.5:5: Likewise, you younger ones, be subject to the elder. Yes, all of you clothe yourselves with humility and subject yourselves to one another; for “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”
en.5:6: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time,
en.5:7: casting all your worries on him, because he cares for you.
en.5:8: Be sober and self-controlled. Be watchful. Your adversary, the devil, walks around like a roaring lion, seeking whom he may devour.
en.5:9: Withstand him steadfast in your faith, knowing that your brothers who are in the world are undergoing the same sufferings.
en.5:10: But may the God of all grace, who called you to his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after you have suffered a little while, perfect, establish, strengthen, and settle you.
en.5:11: To him be the glory and the power forever and ever. Amen.
en.5:12: Through Silvanus, our faithful brother, as I consider him, I have written to you briefly, exhorting and testifying that this is the true grace of God in which you stand.
en.5:13: She who is in Babylon, chosen together with you, greets you. So does Mark, my son.
en.5:14: Greet one another with a kiss of love. Peace be to all of you who are in Christ Jesus. Amen.

pl.1:1: Piotr, Apostół Jezusa Chrystusa, wybranym przychodniom rozproszenia Pontu, Galacyi, Kappadocyi, Azyi i Bithynii,
pl.1:2: Wedle przejrzenia Boga Ojca, ku poświęceniu Ducha, ku posłuszeństwu i pokropieniu krwie Jezusa Chrystusa. Łaska wam i pokój niech się rozmnoży.
pl.1:3: Błogosławiony Bóg i Ojciec Pana naszego Jezusa Chrystusa, który wedle wielkiego miłosierdzia swego odrodził nas ku nadziei żywéj przez zmartwychwstanie Jezusa Chrystusa,
pl.1:4: Ku dziedzictwu nieskazitelnemu i niepokalanemu i niezwiędłemu, na niebiesiech dla was zachowanemu,
pl.1:5: Którzy mocą Bożą strzeżeni jesteście przez wiarę ku zbawieniu zgotowanemu, aby się okazało czasu ostatecznego.
pl.1:6: W czem radować się będziecie trochę teraz, jeźli potrzeba zasmucić się w rozmaitych pokusach,
pl.1:7: Aby doświadczenie wiary waszéj, daleko kosztowniejsze nad złoto, (którego przez ogień próbują), było nalezione ku chwale i czci i sławie, w objawienie Jezusa Chrystusa:
pl.1:8: Którego nie widziawszy, miłujecie, w którego téż teraz nie widząc go wierzycie, a wierząc radować się będziecie weselem niewymownem i chwalebnem,
pl.1:9: Odnosząc koniec wiary waszéj, zbawienie dusz.
pl.1:10: O którem zbawieniu wywiadowali się i badali prorocy, którzy o przyszłéj na was łasce prorokowali:
pl.1:11: Badając się, na który albo na jaki czas okazował w nich Duch Chrystusów, opowiadając pierwéj o utrapieniach tych, które są w Chrystusie, i o chwałach za nimi idących:
pl.1:12: Którym objawiono jest, iż nie samym sobie, ale wam tem usługowali, co się teraz wam opowiada przez te, którzy wam Ewangelią przepowiadali, przez Ducha Ś. z nieba posłanego, na którego pragną patrzyć Aniołowie.
pl.1:13: Przetóż przepasawszy biodra umysłu waszego, trzeźwimi będąc, doskonale miejcie nadzieję o łasce, którą wam ofiarują przez objawienie Chrystusa Jezusa,
pl.1:14: Jako synowie posłuszeństwa, nie przypodobając się przeszłym pożądliwościom nieumiejętności waszéj;
pl.1:15: Ale według onego, który was wezwał Świętego, i wy bądźcie świętymi we wszelakiem obcowaniu:
pl.1:16: Ponieważ napisano jest: Będziecie świętymi, iżem Ja jest święty.
pl.1:17: A jeźli wzywacie Ojca tego, który bez względu na osoby sądzi wedle uczynku każdego, w bojaźni obcujcie czasu przemieszkiwania waszego,
pl.1:18: Wiedząc, iż nie skazitelnemi złotem albo śrebrem jesteście wykupieni od próżnego obcowania waszego ojcowskiego podania;
pl.1:19: Ale drogą krwią, jako baranka niezmazanego i niepokalanego, Chrystusa,
pl.1:20: Acz przejrzanego przed założeniem świata, ale czasów ostatecznych okazanego dla was,
pl.1:21: Którzy przezeń wiernymi jesteście Bogu, który go wzbudził z martwych i dał mu chwałę, aby wiara i nadzieja wasza w Bogu była.
pl.1:22: Oczyściwszy dusze wasze w posłuszeństwie miłości ku braterskiéj miłości, z szczerego serca jedni drugie miłujcie goręcéj,
pl.1:23: Odrodzeni nie z nasienia skazitelnego, ale nieskazitelnego przez słowo Boga żywego i trwającego na wieki.
pl.1:24: Ponieważ wszelkie ciało jako trawa, a wszelka chwała jego jako kwiat trawy: uschła trawa, i kwiat jéj opadł.
pl.1:25: Lecz słowo Pańskie trwa na wieki. A to jest słowo, które wam jest przepowiadane.
pl.2:1: Złożywszy tedy wszelaką złość i wszelaką zdradę i obłudności i zazdrości i wszystkie obmowiska,
pl.2:2: Jako dopiero narodzone niemowlęta, rozumnego bez zdrady mleka pożądajcie, abyście w niem urośli ku zbawieniu:
pl.2:3: Jeźliście jedno skosztowali, iż słodki jest Pan.
pl.2:4: Do którego przystąpiwszy, kamienia żywego, acz od ludzi odrzuconego, ale od Boga wybranego i uczczonego,
pl.2:5: I wy jako żywe kamienie na nim się budujcie w dom duchowny, kapłaństwo święte, ku ofiarowaniu duchownych ofiar, przyjemnych Bogu przez Jezusa Chrystusa.
pl.2:6: Dla czego w Piśmie stoi: Oto kładę w Syonie kamień przedniejszy narożny, wybrany, kosztowny; a kto weń uwierzy, nie będzie zawstydzon.
pl.2:7: Wam tedy wierzącym cześć; a niewierzącym kamień, który odrzucili budujący, ten się stał głową węgielną,
pl.2:8: I kamieniem obrażenia i opoką zgorszenia tym, którzy się o słowo obrażają i nie wierzą, na co i postanowieni są.
pl.2:9: A wy, rodzaj wybrany, królewskie kapłaństwo, naród święty, lud nabycia, abyście cnoty opowiadali tego, który was wezwał z ciemności ku swojéj przedziwnéj światłości,
pl.2:10: Którzy niekiedy nie ludem, a teraz ludem Bożym, którzy co niedostąpili miłosierdzia, a teraz co miłosierdzia dostąpili.
pl.2:11: Najmilejsi! proszę was, jako przychodniów i gościów, abyście się wstrzymawali od pożądliwości cielesnych, które walczą przeciwko duszy,
pl.2:12: Mając obcowanie wasze dobre między pogany, aby w tem, w czem was pomawiają jako złoczyńce, z dobrych uczynków przypatrzywszy się wam, chwalili Boga w dzień nawiedzenia.
pl.2:13: Bądźcież tedy poddani wszelkie muwszelkiemu ludzkiemu stworzeniu dla Boga, chociaż królowi, jako przewyższającemu,
pl.2:14: Chociaż książętom, jako od niego posłanym ku pomście złoczyńców, a ku chwale dobrych.
pl.2:15: Bo tak jest wola Boża, abyście dobrze czyniąc usta zatkali niemądrych ludzi głupstwu.
pl.2:16: Jako wolni, a nie jakoby mając wolność zasłoną złości; ale jako słudzy Boży.
pl.2:17: Wszystkie czcijcie. Braterstwo miłujcie. Boga się bójcie. Króla czcijcie.
pl.2:18: Słudzy, bądźcie poddani panom we wszystkiéj bojaźni, nie tylko dobrym i skromnym, ale téż i przykrym.
pl.2:19: Bo to jest łaska, jeźli kto dla sumnienia Bożego odnosi frasunki, cierpiąc niesprawiedliwie.
pl.2:20: Bo co za chwała, jeźli grzesząc, a policzkowani będąc, cierpicie? Ale jeźli dobrze czyniąc, cierpliwie znosicie, to jest łaska u Boga.
pl.2:21: Albowiem na to wezwani jesteście; bo i Chrystus ucierpiał za nas zostawując wam przykład, abyście naśladowali tropów jego.
pl.2:22: Który grzechu nie uczynił, ani naleziona była zdrada w uściech jego.
pl.2:23: Który, gdy mu złorzeczono, nie złorzeczył: gdy cierpiał, nie groził, lecz się podawał niesprawiedliwie sądzącemu;
pl.2:24: Który sam na ciele swem grzechy nasze nosił na drzewie, abyśmy umarłszy grzechom, żyli sprawiedliwości; którego sinością jesteście uleczeni.
pl.2:25: Boście byli jako owce błądzące; ale teraz jesteście nawróceni do pasterza i biskupa dusz waszych.
pl.3:1: Także i żony niech będą poddane mężom swoim, aby téż, jeźli którzy nie wierzą słowu, przez spólne z żonami mieszkanie bez słowa pozyskani byli,
pl.3:2: Obaczywszy czyste w bojaźni obcowanie wasze.
pl.3:3: Których niech nie będzie zwierzchowne trefienie włosów i obłożenie się złotem, albo strojenie w ubiorze szat;
pl.3:4: Ale który skryty jest serca człowiek, w nieskażeniu spokojnego i skromnego ducha, który jest przed oblicznością Bożą bogaty.
pl.3:5: Albowiem tak niekiedy i święte niewiasty ufające w Bogu, ubierały się, będąc poddane własnym mężom.
pl.3:6: Jako Sara posłuszna była Abrahamowi, nazywając go panem, któréj jesteście córkami, czyniąc dobrze, a nie bojąc się żadnego postrachu.
pl.3:7: Także mężowie spół mieszkając wedle umiejętności, jako słabszemu naczyniu niewieściemu wyrządzając uczciwość, jako téż spólnym dziedziczkom łaski żywota, aby się nie przeszkadzało modlitwom waszym.
pl.3:8: A na koniec wszyscy jednomyślni, spółcierpiący, braterstwa miłośnicy, miłosierni, skromni, pokorni,
pl.3:9: Nie oddawając złego za złe, ani złorzeczeństwa za złorzeczeństwo; lecz przeciwnym obyczajem błogosławiąc: gdyż na to jesteście wezwani, abyście błogosławieństwo dziedzictwem posiedli.
pl.3:10: Albowiem kto chce żywot miłować i oglądać dni dobre, niech pohamuje język swój od złego, i usta jego niech nie mówią zdrady.
pl.3:11: Niech się oddala od złego, a niech czyni dobrze: niech szuka pokoju, a niechaj go ściga;
pl.3:12: Albowiem oczy Pańskie nad sprawiedliwymi, a uszy jego ku prośbie ich; lecz twarz Pańska na działające złości.
pl.3:13: I któż jest, coby wam zaszkodził, jeźli dobrego naśladowcami będziecie?
pl.3:14: Ale i choć co cierpicie dla sprawiedliwości, błogosławieniście: a strachu ich nie strachajcie się, ani sobą trwóżcie.
pl.3:15: Lecz Pana Chrystusa święćcie w sercach waszych; zawżdy gotowymi będąc ku dosyć uczynieniu każdemu domagającemu się od was sprawy o téj nadziei, która w was jest;
pl.3:16: Ale z cichością i z bojaźnią, mając sumnienie dobre, aby w tem, w czem wam uwłaczają, zawstydzili się ci, którzy potwarzają obcowanie wasze dobre w Chrystusie.
pl.3:17: Albowiem lepiéj cierpieć dobrze czyniąc, (jeźliby wola Boża była), niźli źle czyniąc.
pl.3:18: Bo i Chrystus raz umarł za grzechy nasze, sprawiedliwy za niesprawiedliwe, aby nas ofiarował Bogu, acz umartwiony ciałem, ale ożywiony duchem.
pl.3:19: W którym téż tym, którzy w ciemnicy byli duchom, przyszedłszy przepowiadał.
pl.3:20: Którzy niekiedy niewierni byli, kiedy czekali cierpliwości Bożéj za dni Noego, gdy korab budowano: w którym mało, to jest, ośm dusz zachowane były przez wodę.
pl.3:21: Który was i teraz podobnego kształtu zbawia chrzest, nie składanie cielesnego plugastwa, ale zapytanie sumnienia dobrego ku Bogu, przez zmartwychwstanie Jezusa Chrystusa,
pl.3:22: który jest na prawicy Bożéj, połknąwszy śmierć, abyśmy się stali dziedzicmi żywota wiecznego: szedłszy do nieba, poddawszy sobie Anioły i zwierzchności i mocy.
pl.4:1: Gdyż tedy Chrystus ucierpiał w ciele, i wy tąż myślą się uzbrójcie; bo który ucierpiał w ciele, poprzestał grzechów,
pl.4:2: Aby już nie pożądliwościom ludzkim, ale woli Bożéj ostatek czasu żył w ciele.
pl.4:3: Albowiem dosyć na przeszłym czasie ku wypełnieniu woli pogańskiéj tym, którzy chodzili w niepowściągliwościach, pożądliwościach, opilstwach, biesiadach, pijaństwach i niesłusznych bałwochwalstwach.
pl.4:4: W czem dziwują się, iż wy nie zbiegacie się ku temuż zbyteczności zamięszaniu, bluźniąc.
pl.4:5: Którzy dadzą liczbę temu, który gotów jest sądzić żywe i umarłe.
pl.4:6: Dlatego bowiem i umarłym opowiadano Ewangelią, aby sądzeni byli wedle ludzi w ciele, a żyli wedle Boga w duchu.
pl.4:7: Lecz koniec wszystkiego przybliżył się. Przetóż roztropni bądźcie i czujcie w modlitwach.
pl.4:8: A nade wszystko miejcie ustawiczną miłość jedni ku drugim; bo miłość zakrywa wielkość grzechów.
pl.4:9: Goście radzi przyjmujcie, jedni drugie bez szemrania.
pl.4:10: Każdy jako wziął łaskę, usługując nią jeden drugiemu, jako dobrzy szafarze rozlicznéj łaski Bożéj.
pl.4:11: Jeźli który mówi, jako mowy Boże, jeźli który posługuje, jako z siły, której Bóg dodawa, aby we wszem był Bóg pochwalon przez Jezusa Chrystusa, któremu jest chwała i panowanie na wieki wieków. Amen.
pl.4:12: Najmilejsi! nie bądźcie gośćmi w upaleniu, które was potyka ku doświadczeniu, jakoby co nowego na was przychodziło;
pl.4:13: Ale się weselcie, uczęstnikami będąc Chrystusowych ucisków; abyście się i w objawienie chwały jego radując weselili.
pl.4:14: Jeźli was sromocą dla imienia Chrystusowego, błogosławieni będziecie, gdyż, co jest czci i chwały i mocy Bożéj, i który jest Duch jego, na was odpoczywa.
pl.4:15: A żaden z was niechaj nie cierpi jako mężobójca, albo złodziéj, albo złomówca, albo jako cudzego pragnący.
pl.4:16: Lecz jeźli jako Chrześcijanin, niech się nie sroma, a niech chwali Boga w tem imieniu.
pl.4:17: Gdyż czas jest, aby się sąd począł od domu Bożego. A jeźli najprzód od nas, któryż koniec tych, co nie wierzą Ewangelii Bożéj?
pl.4:18: A jeźli sprawiedliwy ledwo zbawion będzie: niezbożny i grzeszny, gdzież się okażą?
pl.4:19: A tak i ci, którzy cierpią wedle woli Bożéj, wiernemu Stworzycielowi niech dusze swe polecają w dobrych uczynkach.
pl.5:1: Starszych tedy, którzy są między wami, proszę, spółstarszy i świadek mąk Chrystusowych, oraz i onéj, która się ma objawić w przyszły czas, uczęstnik chwały:
pl.5:2: Paście trzodę Bożą, która jest między wami, doglądając nie poniewolnie, ale dobrowolnie wedle Boga; ani dla sprosnego zysku, ale z dobréj woli:
pl.5:3: Ani jako panujący nad księżą, ale wzormi będąc trzody z chuci.
pl.5:4: A gdy się okaże książę pasterzów, weźmiecie niewiędnący wieniec chwały.
pl.5:5: Także młodsi poddanymi bądźcie starszym. A wszyscy jedni drugim pokorę pokazujcie, gdyż Bóg pysznym siesię sprzeciwia, a pokornym łaskę dawa.
pl.5:6: Uniżajcież się tedy pod mocną rękę Bożą, aby was wywyższył czasu nawiedzenia:
pl.5:7: Wszystko troskanie wasze składając nań, gdyż on ma pieczą o was.
pl.5:8: Trzeźwymi bądźcie, a czujcie; boć przeciwnik wasz djabeł jako lew ryczący krąży, szukając, kogoby pożarł.
pl.5:9: Któremu się sprzeciwiajcie mocni w wierze, wiedząc, iż tóż utrapienie potyka braterstwo wasze, które jest na świecie.
pl.5:10: A Bóg wszelakiéj łaski, który wezwał nas do wiecznéj swéj chwały w Chrystusie Jezusie, maluczko utrapione, on doskonałe uczyni, utwierdzi i ugruntuje.
pl.5:11: Jemu chwała i moc na wieki wieków. Amen.
pl.5:12: Przez Sylwana, wam wiernego brata, jako rozumiem, pisałem na krótce, napominając i świadzcącświadcząc, iż ta jest prawdziwa łaska Boża, w któréj stoicie.
pl.5:13: Pozdrawia was kościół, który jest w Babilonie, spółwybrany, i Marek, syn mój.
pl.5:14: Pozdrówcie jeden drugiego w pocałowaniu świętem. Łaska wam wszystkim, którzyście w Chrystusie Jezusie. Amen.

it.1:1: Pietro, apostolo di Gesù Cristo, agli eletti che vivono come forestieri nella dispersione del Ponto, della Galazia, della Cappadocia, dell’Asia e della Bitinia,
it.1:2: eletti secondo la prescienza di Dio Padre, mediante la santificazione dello Spirito, ad ubbidire e ad esser cosparsi del sangue di Gesù Cristo: grazia e pace vi siano moltiplicate.
it.1:3: Benedetto sia l’Iddio e Padre del Signor nostro Gesù Cristo, il quale nella sua gran misericordia ci ha fatti rinascere, mediante la risurrezione di Gesù Cristo dai morti,
it.1:4: ad una speranza viva in vista di una eredità incorruttibile, immacolata ed immarcescibile, conservata ne’ cieli per voi,
it.1:5: che dalla potenza di Dio, mediante la fede, siete custoditi per la salvazione che sta per esser rivelata negli ultimi tempi.
it.1:6: Nel che voi esultate, sebbene ora, per un po’ di tempo, se così bisogna, siate afflitti da svariate prove,
it.1:7: affinché la prova della vostra fede, molto più preziosa dell’oro che perisce, eppure è provato col fuoco, risulti a vostra lode, gloria ed onore alla rivelazione di Gesù Cristo:
it.1:8: il quale, benché non l’abbiate veduto, voi amate; nel quale credendo, benché ora non lo vediate, voi gioite d’un’allegrezza ineffabile e gloriosa,
it.1:9: ottenendo il fine della fede: la salvezza della anime.
it.1:10: Questa salvezza è stata l’oggetto delle ricerche e delle investigazioni dei profeti che profetizzarono della grazia a voi destinata.
it.1:11: Essi indagavano qual fosse il tempo e quali le circostanze a cui lo Spirito di Cristo che era in loro accennava, quando anticipatamente testimoniava delle sofferenze di Cristo, e delle glorie che dovevano seguire.
it.1:12: E fu loro rivelato che non per se stessi ma per voi ministravano quelle cose che ora vi sono state annunziate da coloro che vi hanno evangelizzato per mezzo dello Spirito Santo mandato dal cielo; nelle quali cose gli angeli desiderano riguardare bene addentro.
it.1:13: Perciò, avendo cinti i fianchi della vostra mente, e stando sobri, abbiate piena speranza nella grazia che vi sarà recata nella rivelazione di Gesù Cristo;
it.1:14: e, come figliuoli d’ubbidienza, non vi conformate alle concupiscenze del tempo passato quando eravate nell’ignoranza;
it.1:15: ma come Colui che vi ha chiamati è santo, anche voi siate santi in tutta la vostra condotta;
it.1:16: poiché sta scritto: Siate santi, perché io son santo.
it.1:17: E se invocate come Padre Colui che senza riguardi personali giudica secondo l’opera di ciascuno, conducetevi con timore durante il tempo del vostro pellegrinaggio;
it.1:18: sapendo che non con cose corruttibili, con argento o con oro, siete stati riscattati dal vano modo di vivere tramandatovi dai padri,
it.1:19: ma col prezioso sangue di Cristo, come d’agnello senza difetto né macchia,
it.1:20: ben preordinato prima della fondazione del mondo, ma manifestato negli ultimi tempi per voi,
it.1:21: i quali per mezzo di lui credete in Dio che l’ha risuscitato dai morti e gli ha dato gloria, onde la vostra fede e la vostra speranza fossero in Dio.
it.1:22: Avendo purificate le anime vostre coll’ubbidienza alla verità per arrivare a un amor fraterno non finto, amatevi l’un l’altro di cuore, intensamente,
it.1:23: poiché siete stati rigenerati non da seme corruttibile, ma incorruttibile, mediante la parola di Dio vivente e permanente.
it.1:24: Poiché Ogni carne è com’erba, e ogni sua gloria come il fior dell’erba. L’erba si secca, e il fiore cade;
it.1:25: ma la parola del Signore permane in eterno. E questa è la Parola della Buona Novella che vi è stata annunziata.
it.2:1: Gettando dunque lungi da voi ogni malizia, e ogni frode, e le ipocrisie, e le invidie, ed ogni sorta di maldicenze, come bambini pur ora nati,
it.2:2: appetite il puro latte spirituale, onde per esso cresciate per la salvezza,
it.2:3: se pure avete gustato che il Signore è buono.
it.2:4: Accostandovi a lui, pietra vivente, riprovata bensì dagli uomini ma innanzi a Dio eletta e preziosa, anche voi,
it.2:5: come pietre viventi, siete edificati qual casa spirituale, per esser un sacerdozio santo per offrire sacrifici spirituali, accettevoli a Dio per mezzo di Gesù Cristo.
it.2:6: Poiché si legge nella Scrittura: Ecco, io pongo in Sion una pietra angolare, eletta, preziosa; e chiunque crede in lui non sarà confuso.
it.2:7: Per voi dunque che credete ell’è preziosa; ma per gl’increduli la pietra che gli edificatori hanno riprovata è quella ch’è divenuta la pietra angolare, e una pietra d’inciampo e un sasso d’intoppo:
it.2:8: essi, infatti, essendo disubbidienti, intoppano nella Parola; ed a questo sono stati anche destinati.
it.2:9: Ma voi siete una generazione eletta, un real sacerdozio, una gente santa, un popolo che Dio s’è acquistato, affinché proclamiate le virtù di Colui che vi ha chiamati dalle tenebre alla sua maravigliosa luce;
it.2:10: voi, che già non eravate un popolo, ma ora siete il popolo di Dio; voi, che non avevate ottenuto misericordia, ma ora avete ottenuto misericordia.
it.2:11: Diletti, io v’esorto come stranieri e pellegrini ad astenervi dalle carnali concupiscenze, che guerreggiano contro l’anima,
it.2:12: avendo una buona condotta fra i Gentili; affinché laddove sparlano di voi come di malfattori, essi, per le vostre buone opere che avranno osservate, glorifichino Iddio nel giorno ch’Egli li visiterà.
it.2:13: Siate soggetti, per amor del Signore, ad ogni autorità creata dagli uomini: al re, come al sovrano;
it.2:14: ai governatori, come mandati da lui per punire i malfattori e per dar lode a quelli che fanno il bene.
it.2:15: Poiché questa è la volontà di Dio: che, facendo il bene, turiate la bocca alla ignoranza degli uomini stolti;
it.2:16: come liberi, ma non usando già della libertà quel manto che copra la malizia, ma come servi di Dio.
it.2:17: Onorate tutti. Amate la fratellanza. Temete Iddio. Rendete onore al re.
it.2:18: Domestici, siate con ogni timore soggetti ai vostri padroni; non solo ai buoni e moderati, ma anche a quelli che son difficili.
it.2:19: Poiché questo è accettevole: se alcuno, per motivo di coscienza davanti a Dio, sopporta afflizioni, patendo ingiustamente.
it.2:20: Infatti, che vanto c’è se, peccando ed essendo malmenati, voi sopportate pazientemente? Ma se facendo il bene, eppur patendo, voi sopportate pazientemente, questa è cosa grata a Dio.
it.2:21: Perché a questo siete stati chiamati: poiché anche Cristo ha patito per voi, lasciandovi un esempio, onde seguiate le sue orme;
it.2:22: egli, che non commise peccato, e nella cui bocca non fu trovata alcuna frode;
it.2:23: che, oltraggiato, non rendeva gli oltraggi; che, soffrendo, non minacciava, ma si rimetteva nelle mani di Colui che giudica giustamente;
it.2:24: egli, che ha portato egli stesso i nostri peccati nel suo corpo, sul legno, affinché, morti al peccato, vivessimo per la giustizia, e mediante le cui lividure siete stati sanati.
it.2:25: Poiché eravate erranti come pecore; ma ora siete tornati al Pastore e Vescovo delle anime vostre.
it.3:1: Parimente voi, mogli, siate soggette ai vostri mariti, affinché se anche ve ne sono che non ubbidiscono alla Parola, siano guadagnati senza parola dalla condotta delle loro mogli,
it.3:2: quand’avranno considerato la vostra condotta casta e rispettosa.
it.3:3: Il vostro ornamento non sia l’esteriore che consiste nell’intrecciatura dei capelli, nel mettersi attorno dei gioielli d’oro, nell’indossar vesti sontuose
it.3:4: ma l’essere occulto del cuore fregiato dell’ornamento incorruttibile dello spirito benigno e pacifico, che agli occhi di Dio è di gran prezzo.
it.3:5: E così infatti si adornavano una volta le sante donne speranti in Dio, stando soggette ai loro mariti,
it.3:6: come Sara che ubbidiva ad Abramo, chiamandolo signore; della quale voi siete ora figliuole, se fate il bene e non vi lasciate turbare da spavento alcuno.
it.3:7: Parimente, voi, mariti, convivete con esse colla discrezione dovuta al vaso più debole ch’è il femminile. Portate loro onore, poiché sono anch’esse eredi con voi della grazia della vita, onde le vostre preghiere non siano impedite.
it.3:8: Infine, siate tutti concordi, compassionevoli, pieni d’amor fraterno, pietosi, umili;
it.3:9: non rendendo male per male, od oltraggio per oltraggio, ma, al contrario, benedicendo; poiché a questo siete stati chiamati onde ereditiate la benedizione.
it.3:10: Perché: Chi vuol amar la vita e veder buoni giorni, rattenga la sua lingua dal male e le sue labbra dal parlar con frode;
it.3:11: si ritragga dal male e faccia il bene; cerchi la pace e la procacci;
it.3:12: perché gli occhi del Signore sono sui giusti e i suoi orecchi sono attenti alle loro supplicazioni; ma la faccia del Signore è contro quelli che fanno il male.
it.3:13: E chi è colui che vi farà del male, se siete zelanti del bene?
it.3:14: Ma anche se aveste a soffrire per cagione di giustizia, beati voi! E non vi sgomenti la paura che incutono e non vi conturbate;
it.3:15: anzi abbiate nei vostri cuori un santo timore di Cristo il Signore, pronti sempre a rispondere a vostra difesa a chiunque vi domanda ragione della speranza che è in voi, ma con dolcezza e rispetto; avendo una buona coscienza;
it.3:16: onde laddove sparlano di voi, siano svergognati quelli che calunniano la vostra buona condotta in Cristo.
it.3:17: Perché è meglio, se pur tale è la volontà di Dio, che soffriate facendo il bene, anziché facendo il male.
it.3:18: Poiché anche Cristo ha sofferto un volta per i peccati, egli giusto per gl’ingiusti, per condurci a Dio; essendo stato messo a morte, quanto alla carne, ma vivificato quanto allo spirito;
it.3:19: e in esso andò anche a predicare agli spiriti ritenuti in carcere,
it.3:20: i quali un tempo furon ribelli, quando la pazienza di Dio aspettava, ai giorni di Noè, mentre si preparava l’arca; nella quale poche anime, cioè otto, furon salvate tra mezzo all’acqua.
it.3:21: Alla qual figura corrisponde il battesimo (non il nettamento delle sozzure della carne ma la richiesta di una buona coscienza fatta a Dio), il quale ora salva anche voi, mediante la resurrezione di Gesù Cristo,
it.3:22: che, essendo andato in cielo, è alla destra di Dio, dove angeli, principati e potenze gli son sottoposti.
it.4:1: Poiché dunque Cristo ha sofferto nella carne, anche voi armatevi di questo stesso pensiero, che, cioè, colui che ha sofferto nella carne ha cessato dal peccato,
it.4:2: per consacrare il tempo che resta da passare nella carne, non più alle concupiscenze degli uomini, ma alla volontà di Dio.
it.4:3: Poiché basta l’aver dato il vostro passato a fare la volontà de’ Gentili col vivere nelle lascivie, nelle concupiscenze, nelle ubriachezze, nelle gozzoviglie, negli sbevazzamenti, e nelle nefande idolatrie.
it.4:4: Per la qual cosa trovano strano che voi non corriate con loro agli stessi eccessi di dissolutezza, e dicon male di voi.
it.4:5: Essi renderanno ragione a colui ch’è pronto a giudicare i vivi ed i morti.
it.4:6: Poiché per questo è stato annunziato l’Evangelo anche ai morti; onde fossero bensì giudicati secondo gli uomini quanto alla carne, ma vivessero secondo Dio quanto allo spirito.
it.4:7: Or la fine di ogni cosa è vicina; siate dunque temperati e vigilanti alle orazioni.
it.4:8: Soprattutto, abbiate amore intenso gli uni per gli altri, perché l’amore copre moltitudine di peccati.
it.4:9: Siate ospitali gli uni verso gli altri senza mormorare.
it.4:10: Come buoni amministratori della svariata grazia di Dio, ciascuno, secondo il dono che ha ricevuto, lo faccia valere al servizio degli altri.
it.4:11: Se uno parla, lo faccia come annunziando oracoli di Dio; se uno esercita un ministerio, lo faccia come con la forza che Dio fornisce, onde in ogni cosa sia glorificato Iddio per mezzo di Gesù Cristo, al quale appartengono la gloria e l’imperio nei secoli de’ secoli. Amen.
it.4:12: Diletti, non vi stupite della fornace accesa in mezzo a voi per provarvi, quasiché vi avvenisse qualcosa di strano.
it.4:13: Anzi in quanto partecipate alle sofferenze di Cristo, rallegratevene, affinché anche alla rivelazione della sua gloria possiate rallegrarvi giubilando.
it.4:14: Se siete vituperati per il nome di Cristo, beati voi! perché lo Spirito di gloria, lo spirito di Dio, riposa su voi.
it.4:15: Nessuno di voi patisca come omicida, o ladro, o malfattore, o come ingerentesi nei fatti altrui;
it.4:16: ma se uno patisce come Cristiano, non se ne vergogni, ma glorifichi Iddio portando questo nome.
it.4:17: Poiché è giunto il tempo in cui il giudicio ha da cominciare dalla casa di Dio; e se comincia prima da noi, qual sarà la fine di quelli che non ubbidiscono al Vangelo di Dio?
it.4:18: E se il giusto è appena salvato, dove comparirà l’empio e il peccatore?
it.4:19: Perciò anche quelli che soffrono secondo la volontà di Dio, raccomandino le anime loro al fedel Creatore, facendo il bene.
it.5:1: Io esorto dunque gli anziani che sono fra voi, io che sono anziano con loro e testimone delle sofferenze di Cristo e che sarò pure partecipe della gloria che ha da essere manifestata:
it.5:2: Pascete il gregge di Dio che è fra voi, non forzatamente, ma volonterosamente secondo Dio; non per un vil guadagno, ma di buon animo;
it.5:3: e non come signoreggiando quelli che vi son toccati in sorte, ma essendo gli esempi del gregge.
it.5:4: E quando sarà apparito il sommo Pastore, otterrete la corona della gloria che non appassisce.
it.5:5: Parimente, voi più giovani, siate soggetti agli anziani. E tutti rivestitevi d’umiltà gli uni verso gli altri, perché Dio resiste ai superbi ma dà grazia agli umili.
it.5:6: Umiliatevi dunque sotto la potente mano di Dio, affinché Egli v’innalzi a suo tempo,
it.5:7: gettando su lui ogni vostra sollecitudine, perch’Egli ha cura di voi.
it.5:8: Siate sobri, vegliate; il vostro avversario, il diavolo, va attorno a guisa di leon ruggente cercando chi possa divorare.
it.5:9: Resistetegli stando fermi nella fede, sapendo che le medesime sofferenze si compiono nella vostra fratellanza sparsa per il mondo.
it.5:10: Or l’Iddio d’ogni grazia, il quale vi ha chiamati alla sua eterna gloria in Cristo, dopo che avrete sofferto per breve tempo, vi perfezionerà Egli stesso, vi renderà saldi, vi fortificherà.
it.5:11: A lui sia l’imperio, nei secoli dei secoli. Amen.
it.5:12: Per mezzo di Silvano, nostro fedel fratello, com’io lo stimo, v’ho scritto brevemente esortandovi; e attestando che questa è la vera grazia di Dio; in essa state saldi.
it.5:13: La chiesa che è in Babilonia eletta come voi, vi saluta; e così fa Marco, il mio figliuolo.
it.5:14: Salutatevi gli uni gli altri con un bacio d’amore. Pace a voi tutti che siete in Cristo.
